title: Bún chay (rice noodle bowl with lemongrass tofu)
steps: Cook the rice noodles according to the packet and rinse in cold water.
Finely chop the lemongrass and garlic, dice the tofu and mix it with the lemongrass, garlic and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Stir the remaining soy sauce with the lime juice, maple syrup and 3 tbsp water.
Arrange the lettuce, noodles, vegetable strips and tofu in bowls, pour over the sauce and sprinkle with mint and peanuts.
